name: Text Input
description: Single-line bound text input. The only plain text-input component type in this codebase — no dxtextbox/textbox type exists, do not invent one. A multiline variant is the same type with multiline:true (see atoms/text-input-multiline.json).

dset.description: Dataset name the value binds to, e.g. "DsFrmHeaderEntry" for header fields or "DsFrmDetails1" for a grid row.

bind.description: Field name in the dataset, conventionally "<MODULE_PREFIX>_<COLUMN>", e.g. "ALLOC_DOCNO".

label.description: Usually empty string "" when a separate lbl atom is used in the field wrapper.

variant.description: "outlined" (some examples use inputVariant instead of variant — check sibling controls in the same file for which prop name is used).
